reports.title: Jean James
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: the Trust has undertaken the following actions: 1) We have reviewed the hospital information system, known as MEDITECH V6 to find a solution to prevent further risk for patients who on assessment are at risk of developing a venous thromboembolism episode (VTE). The proposal is for the VTE assessment screen to automatically move to the prescription screen if a patient has been identified as being at risk. The medical staff will be required to complete the prescription for the thromboprophylaxis
promises.summary: Review MEDITECH V6 to automatically move VTE assessment to prescription screen and require completion of thromboprophylaxis prescription

promises.quote: 2) We have introduced a new format for clinical handover of patients from the Acute Medical Unit to their base ward. This acuity handover tool is patient focused and highlights key indicators regarding the patient's healthcare needs, and treatment plan.
promises.summary: Introduce new clinical handover format from Acute Medical Unit to base ward

promises.quote: 3) Communication between the pharmacy team and escalation of omissions is currently the subject of an internal review where the team are in the process of identifying workable solutions.
promises.summary: Internal review of pharmacy team communication and omission escalation

promises.quote: 4) The Trust has a VTE policy based on NICE guidelines and we are currently reviewing the policy to encompass the technical changes made to the VTE assessment and prescribing process. We will hold a Trust wide clinical symposium in the autumn to ensure staff have the opportunity to discuss current issues regarding the management of patients at risk of VTE.
promises.summary: Review VTE policy and hold Trust-wide clinical symposium on VTE management
